title: Genesis 6:17: God announces the flood to destroy all flesh
summary: Genesis 6:17 alone on the slide: God says He is bringing the flood of water upon the earth to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life from under heaven; everything on the earth shall perish.

text.text: 17 “Behold, I, even I am bringing the flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life, from under heaven; everything that is on the earth shall perish.

keywords: everything on the earth shall perish
bringing the flood upon the earth
